scripts.use:local: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('.env.local','.env')" && node -e "console.log('>> Da chuyen sang: LOCAL (.env.local)')"
scripts.use:render: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('.env.render','.env')" && node -e "console.log('>> Da chuyen sang: RENDER - DU LIEU THAT (.env.render)')"
scripts.env:which: node -e "try{var d=require('fs').readFileSync('.env','utf8');console.log('Dang dung:', /^\s*DATABASE_URL\s*=\s*\S/m.test(d)?'RENDER (cloud, du lieu that)':'LOCAL')}catch(e){console.log('Chua co file .env - chay: npm run use:local hoac npm run use:render')}"
